secrets.name: The Unwritten Room
secrets.text: Behind the slot on the landing there is a room with clean walls, the only clean walls in this part of the library: a desk, a lamp, an inkwell, and one pen, laid down. Nobody has written anything here yet. It is waiting for you to begin.

meta.label: The Written Stair
meta.blurb: A stair, and on every inch of it somebody has written something: a name, a date, I was here, I am still here, forgive me. The oldest writing is at the bottom. You look for your own hand. You find it.
